# Test mod for triggering "unknown trigger" errors
# These trigger names are intentionally made up to trigger error messages

namespace = re_unknown_trigger

re_unknown_trigger.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = re_unknown_trigger.0001.t
	desc = re_unknown_trigger.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		# Valid trigger for context
		is_alive = yes

		# INTENTIONAL: Made-up trigger names to trigger registry lookup errors
		this_trigger_does_not_exist_at_all = yes
		completely_fake_trigger_name = yes
		is_definitely_not_a_real_trigger = yes
		has_nonexistent_trait_modifier = yes
		any_made_up_scope_trigger = {
			fake_nested_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = re_unknown_trigger.0001.a
	}
}

re_unknown_trigger.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = re_unknown_trigger.0002.t
	desc = re_unknown_trigger.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		# Test variations of trigger patterns
		xyzzy_completely_random = yes
		test_numbered_trigger_99 = yes
		UPPERCASE_TRIGGER = yes
		MixedCase_Trigger = yes

		# Lists with fake triggers
		OR = {
			fake_or_trigger_1 = yes
			fake_or_trigger_2 = yes
		}

		AND = {
			fake_and_trigger_1 = yes
			fake_and_trigger_2 = no
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = re_unknown_trigger.0002.a
	}
}
